name: Nequi
body: HSTS with preload, nosniff, a CSP from default-src 'self', and a sitemap. But /personas/creditos declares itself canonical while its es-CO, es, and x-default alternates all point to the home page.
lesson: hreflang alternates must point to the same page in each language, including the page itself.
summary: www.nequi.com.co scores 81 out of 100 (B). 2 checks fail now, 20 are at risk, and 24 pass. Fix first: 6 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 6 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /negocios, /creditos-emergencia-sismo, /personas/moneda-extranjera, /personas/moneda-extranjera/dolares-digitales. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.evidence: script-src allows 'unsafe-inline', script-src allows 'unsafe-eval', object-src is not 'none', base-uri is not set.
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.

fix.title: Lighthouse scores performance 42/100 on mobile
fix.evidence: Lighthouse 13.5.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 21.9 s, Total Blocking Time 573 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 0.039, Speed Index 9.0 s.
fix.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.

fix.title: 25 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.
